title: Reply to the comment by E. Menendez-Proupin on "Multi-phonon Raman scattering in semiconductor nanocrystals: Importance of non-adiabatic transitions"
abstract: In our recent paper [Phys. Rev. B 65, 075316 (2002)], the selection rules for the Raman scattering in spherical nanocrystals are analyzed. Here we show, that a physically expedient choice of the coordinate system, related to the polarization vector of the incoming or scattered light, simplifies and clarifies the analysis.
